items.title: Norman Mason Interview, 1960-02-06
items.q: I saw that Jack Parr show here the other night, not long ago

ctx.x: But you never did go there except through there? Never did go there, just passed through there. What kind of songs did you hear when you were a child?

Well, they call them Calypso now. They call them Calypso songs now, but they used to make them up around that song when I was a little fella. They are just like they do now, but of course nobody paid any attention to them. I remember one that used to sing about the bonefish, it used to call the bonefish song. Every man had his own bonefish. They just make them up like they went along? Oh yeah, that's just the way they do it. I guess it's like everything else. There was some people who was just cut out for that…
I bet that'll be something, huh?
